seoTitle: Springfield Public Schools Calendar 2026–27 | Springfield, MO
seoDescription: Springfield, Missouri students start Aug. 25, 2026, and finish May 27, 2027. See breaks, professional days, the PYP calendar, official PDF, and ICS.
heroSummary: For students following the main district calendar, school starts Tuesday, August 25, 2026, and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break runs November 25–27. Winter Break runs December 21–31. The district is closed January 1, and January 4 is a professional day, so students return January 5. Spring Break runs March 15–19. March 22 is a professional day, so students return March 23. Boyd, Field, and Rountree use a separate PYP calendar.

calendarNotes: The main 2026–27 SPS calendar has 171 student days. August 25 is also the first day for Wonder Years and Early Childhood Special Education. PYP families should use the separate calendar linked in Downloads. Parent/teacher conferences run October 26–30, but the PDF does not label that entire window as no school. Winter Break ends December 31; January 1 is district closed and January 4 is a professional day, so students return January 5. Spring Break ends March 19, but March 22 is a professional day, so the fourth quarter and regular classes resume March 23. Explore is listed for June 3–30 after the regular student year and applies to summer-learning participants.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Springfield Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students following the main SPS calendar start Tuesday, August 25, 2026. The PDF also identifies this as the first day for Wonder Years and Early Childhood Special Education. PYP students use a separate calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21–31, 2026. January 1 is district closed and January 4 is a professional day with students out, so regular classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SPS students return after Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 15–19. Monday, March 22 is a professional day with students out, so students return Tuesday, March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: Are students out for the entire October 26–30 conference window?
calendarFaqs.a: The annual PDF lists Parent/Teacher Conferences for October 26–30 but does not label the entire range as no school. October 23 is the professional day when students are out. Check school messages for conference appointments or schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SPS schools use the PYP calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Boyd, Field, and Rountree elementary schools use the separate SPS PYP calendar. The main district ICS does not include that calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the SPS school-hour tiers?
calendarFaqs.a: Tier One runs 7:20 a.m.–2:20 p.m., Tier Two 8:10 a.m.–3:10 p.m., and Tier Three 9 a.m.–4 p.m. Boyd, Field, and Rountree are in Tier One. Check the official hours page for a specific school or program.

sourceReviewDetails: Checked the complete one-page district PDF and its 171-student-day label.

Compared the first and last days, Fall Break structure, the return date after Spring Break, and total student days with the official 2025–26 district calendar.
Kept the October conference window as an academic entry because SPS does not label the entire range as no school.
Confirmed that SPS publishes a separate PYP calendar; those dates are not merged into the main district dataset or ICS.
Checked the current three-tier start/end-time page and confirmed that Boyd, Field, and Rountree are listed in Tier One.
